status_note: 3d-model-pipeline stage 7a (skill check figure 2026-10-14): UE import of the Beowulf look-dev run 20261014-h2-lookdev-t5 (profile beowulf-h2-lookdev-t5, profile_version 2: generic h2_bake H2 figure + UV1 in metres, MatID, Edge, graded BC/ORM, metal_f0; TeamAccent t4 written into the same run) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt (normaliser h2-lookdev/1) onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/Beowulf/Rig/SK_Beowulf_Skeleton. MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (UseTeamAccent, UseUV1Metres) with the TeamAccent mask of the look-dev run and the look-dev LUT as is (UE look-dev iteration 0); base on M_UM_BaseMarker in vertex-mask mode: two-tier Tripo base, the team ring by height (bake t4 textures.team_mask.base_band.height_m [0.003, 0.029] -> vertex mask UM_Mask.R; VertexMaskWeight 1, SideBandWeight 0; HANDBOOK §2.9, W2-c). Teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision 'accents + ring'). At most 'technically imported'; art acceptance of the model by delegation (stage 4 r1 pass 8.1, pair Sol + Opus, evidence/acceptance/20261014-r1/final.json). Rev 2 (UE look-dev r2, 2026-10-14, light mode by delegation, applied by ue_hero_lookdev.py apply-mi onto the run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import without re-import): LUT T_UM_MatLUT_Beowulf_UE_r2 (wool_coarse sheen 0.03 tint 0.8 specular 0.18; linen the same; leather_smooth specular 0.3 roughness 0.5; steel_blued F0 x1.3, metal_forged F0 x1.2) and the AN-32 Fix slots: A on MatID class 0 legacy_bake (beard, eyes; the LUT cannot reach class 0) FixGainA 0.55, B on class 8 leather_worn FixGainB 1.3. Reason: review r1 fur 3.7x / beard 3.05x the concept luminance against skin 1.35x (pale beige fur, blond beard), steel 0.88x, leather_worn 0.97x (overrides note_ue_r2).
